# Operating practice prompts

Prompts for Operating practices.

| ID | Title | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [P-OP-01](p-op-01.md) | Draft a worker brief | Draft one dispatched worker's own brief: its bound inputs, its exact output path, and its completion test, so the worker never has to guess what finishing its own item actually means. |
